thread:
Ava: Quick pitch — we need a 30-second Friday ritual to cap the week. no meetings, no slides, just one tiny thing everyone does before signing off. toss your suggestions! :sparkles:
Diego: 3 deep breaths together (camera optional). call it 'The Exhale' — feels calming and takes 10–15s. :ok_hand:
Maya: Love that. or a single silly one-line news headline from each team, like 'Infra solves the snack shortage' — share in thread, quick chuckle. :newspaper:
Riley: What about a throwback photo flash? everyone posts one 1s GIF or emoji representing their week. scroll + react. low friction. :camera_with_flash:
Sam: Tiny ritual idea: one person drops a micro-commendation for someone else — 1 sentence, public kudos. rotates each Friday. builds culture fast. :raised_hands:
Ava: Ooh rotating kudos is neat. combine with a 3-breath exhale? kudos + exhale = 20s total.
Diego: If we do the GIF flash + kudos, we can automate with reminder-bot: "reminder-bot: heads-up: post your GIF + one-line kudos in #random. I'll thread them."
reminder-bot: Scheduled reminder posted: "Friday Ritual — GIF + 1-line kudos. 3 PM PT."
Maya: Also proposal: no perfect posts, rules: <15s, work-optional, keep it silly. removes pressure. :balloon:
Riley: vote — which variant? A) Exhale + kudos, B) GIF + kudos, C) One-line headline + kudos. react with :one:, :two:, :three:.
Sam: :two: (GIF + kudos) from me. way more meme potential.
Ava: :two: here too. okay majority leaning GIF + kudos. I'll spin up a Slack shortcut/quick template so it's easy to post.
Diego: Love it. if it sticks, maybe small reward (office sticker?) for best GIF-of-the-week. low effort, high joy.
Maya: Promise: no long threads. 30s, done. see you Friday. :tada:
